days.title: Subterranean Wonders and Industrial Heritage
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Torca del Carlista
stops.detail: In it are natural riches such as the Torca del Carlista cave, the largest underground cave in Europe, as well as the Pozalagua cave and its display of eccentric stalactites and that of Santa Isabel.

stops.name: museo de Dolomitas
stops.detail: In these buildings, the park's interpretation center, the Dolomite Museum, and the tourism office have been installed.

days.title: Ancient Burial Grounds of Galupa
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Dolmen Galupa I
stops.detail: The tumulus of the Galupa I dolmen has a semicircular floor plan 18 by 16 meters in diameter and a height of 2.20 meters.

stops.name: Dolmen Galupa II
stops.detail: The burial chamber of the Galupa II dolmen is rectangular with a length of 1.85 meters and a width of 1 meter.
